images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame around the game itself. Investigation game screenshot, landscape 16:9, top-down view of a brushed stainless-steel morgue evidence table under cold flickering fluorescent light. In the center lies a dead man's locked smartphone, slightly rotated, vibrating with an incoming call: blurred night-city bokeh wallpaper, a large circular avatar with expanding ring pulses, a red decline button and a green accept button, frosted notification cards below, one expanding to reveal more text; the battery icon in the corner blinks red at 12 percent. Around it: a clear plastic evidence bag with red-and-white tape and a handwritten form, an L-shaped forensic scale ruler, and dark translucent investigation HUD panels listing clues and response choices with keyboard hints. Palette blue-black, steel grey, cold white-blue light, ice-blue UI accent, alarm red; strong vignette, grain. Korean UI text: "잠금 해제 불가", "윤서", "전화 거절".

Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame around the game itself. Climax screen of a locked-phone investigation game, landscape 16:9, top-down on a cold steel evidence table in near darkness. The locked smartphone in the center now shows an emergency SOS call screen washed in deep red: a large emergency number, a pulsing red SOS circle with rings, a frosted location card naming a city hall basement records room, and below it the final expanded message notification from a trapped friend; battery at 6 percent, screen dimmed. On the left, three cream evidence tags pinned with red push-pins, handwritten blue-ink notes, joined to the phone by taut red string. On the right, a dark HUD panel with location and battery rows and a red heartbeat-like call signal line, plus an ending title and two decision buttons, the rescue choice glowing red. Cold blue-white rim light versus red phone glow; grain, vignette. Korean UI text: "긴급 통화 · SOS", "구청 B2 기록실", "마지막 수신인". Continuity with image A: the trapped friend is "윤서" (the notification sender and pinned note say 윤서, never 지현 or any other name); the phone clock reads "23:52" and every time shown is later than 23:17; no street addresses.
